name: CDX plywood
description: Softwood plywood, C/D faces, exposure 1: subfloor and sheathing. Sold as 1/2in, 5/8in and 23/32in ("3/4") 4x8 sheets. Panels act as diaphragms and braces, so there are no beam values.
source: APA D510C-2020 Panel Design Specification Table 13, approximate weight: 1/2in 1.5 psf, 23/32in 2.2 psf (≈36 pcf)

name: 7/16in OSB sheathing
description: Oriented strand board, 7/16in, 4x8: the usual wall and roof sheathing.
source: APA D510C-2020 Panel Design Specification Table 13, approximate weight: OSB 7/16in 1.4 psf (≈38 pcf), 23/32in 2.4 psf (≈40 pcf)

name: 23/32in OSB subfloor (tongue and groove)
description: Oriented strand board, 23/32in tongue-and-groove subfloor panel, 4x8.
source: APA D510C-2020 Panel Design Specification Table 13, approximate weight: OSB 7/16in 1.4 psf (≈38 pcf), 23/32in 2.4 psf (≈40 pcf)
